list: The official 55 trophies with Sunset Ledger guides, compiled 2026-11-20

trophies.guide: The platinum, awarded the moment the other 54 trophies are all yours. There is no shortcut and no separate task: work the Roadmap in order — story, strands, sightseeing, the long counters, then cleanup — and keep a manual save before the late-story choice so the game's one missable trophy can never strand you at 54 out of 55.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.source: PlayStation 5 trophy list (official), via PSNProfiles — platinum requirements
steps: Finish the story and every character strand (Stages 1 and 2 of the Roadmap).
Clear the activity and exploration trophies while the map is fresh (Stage 3).
Grind the long counters — stunts, range medals, WAiNK spots, cards, vaults — a few at a time (Stage 4).
Sweep the one-off moments and the missable in cleanup, then close out 100% completion (Stage 5).

trophies.guide: The prologue. Gone Fishing introduces Jason on the Leonida coast and teaches movement, driving and the basics of trouble. It cannot be missed: the trophy pops as the mission's closing cutscene hands you free roam.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list: story trophies
steps: Start a new game and play the opening mission, Gone Fishing.
Follow the markers through the fishing trip until the closing cutscene.
The trophy unlocks as free roam opens — there are no performance targets to hit.

trophies.guide: Story progression, pure and simple. Chapter 1 sets Lucia's release and the pair's first jobs in motion; finish its final mission and the trophy is yours. Chapter select stays available after the credits, so nothing here can be lost.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
steps: Play through the Chapter 1 mission chain from the prologue.
Complete the chapter's final mission to unlock the trophy.

trophies.guide: Awarded for closing out Chapter 2, where the money starts moving and so does the trouble. The name is PlayStation's own censorship, asterisks and all — the gate that checks this guide matches it character for character. Just keep following the story markers.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list: story trophies
steps: Continue the story into Chapter 2 after Chapter 1's finale.
Finish the chapter's closing mission; the trophy pops on completion.

trophies.guide: Chapter 3 brings the campaign home to Vice City proper. Complete its final mission for the trophy. If you are pacing yourself, this is the chapter where the strand missions for Andy, Kenton and the rest begin to open up — worth starting alongside the story rather than after it.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
steps: Play the Chapter 3 story missions in Vice City.
Complete the chapter finale to unlock the trophy.

trophies.guide: The end of Chapter 4 is the campaign's point of no return in spirit: a major choice waits in the stretch that follows, and the game's one missable trophy hangs on it. Make a manual save in a separate slot when this trophy pops — future you, hunting at 2 a.m., says thanks.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list: story trophies
steps: Complete the Chapter 4 mission chain.
When the trophy pops, save immediately into a fresh manual slot — this is your insurance for Actions Speak Louder.

trophies.guide: The gold for finishing the main story. The final mission is a long one with several phases and little checkpoint generosity, so go in stocked: full armor, snacks, and the best weapons for both characters. Any ending route counts — the trophy is for completion, not for a particular choice.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
steps: Reach the final mission through the closing story chain.
Stock armor, health items and ammunition for both Jason and Lucia before you start.
Complete the finale and let the credits roll — the gold pops with mission completion.

trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is an early story mission — a favor that turns into a chase, and the game's way of teaching you the partner switch. It is on the critical path and cannot be skipped or failed permanently; its retry checkpoints are generous.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list: story trophies
steps: Accept the Breakfast Run mission early in Chapter 1.
Complete the delivery and the escape that follows it.

trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is the campaign's big set-piece robbery, with a planning board, a crew and three loud minutes at the end. Any approach works for the trophy — the loud route is faster to learn, the quiet route easier to survive. It pops on mission completion regardless of the take.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
steps: Unlock The Cartel Heist through the story; it lands late in the campaign.
Complete the planning steps and pick either approach — both count.
Finish the heist and escape; the trophy unlocks on completion.

trophies.guide: Child's Play is a mid-story mission with the tonal swerve its title hints at. It sits on the main path in the Chapter 2 stretch of the campaign; finish it and move on. No optional objectives are tied to the trophy.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list: story trophies
steps: Start Child's Play when it appears on the story path.
Complete the mission — the trophy pops at the results screen.

trophies.guide: Headliners is the story mission built around a very public takedown — expect cameras, crowds and a wanted level that arrives right on schedule. Completion is all that matters; the style points are their own reward.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
steps: Play into the Headliners mission on the story path.
Complete the takedown and lose the heat to finish the mission.

trophies.guide: The VCIA Takedown takes the campaign to Vice City International Airport. It is a story mission, so it cannot be missed; bring a fast car for the airfield stretch, and do not worry about the take — there isn't one, just the message being sent.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list: story trophies
steps: Start VCIA Takedown when the story sends you to the airport.
Complete the takedown and the departure that follows.

trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is one of the late campaign's loudest missions — a full assault that uses everything the game has taught you so far. Completion-based, like every story trophy; if a phase keeps killing you, falling back to the checkpoint with fresh armor is the intended rhythm, not a failure state.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
steps: Reach Operation Savage Glory in the late story.
Fight through the assault phases and finish the mission.

trophies.guide: The second gold, and the real platinum gate. The 100% checklist is tracked in the pause menu: story, strands, hobbies and pastimes, random events, collectibles and the miscellany tail. You do not need gold medals or every stunt in the game — only the checklist's own items. Work it in the Roadmap's order and check the percentage after every session; the last few points are almost always random events and a collectible category you forgot.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — GTA VI 100% completion checklist
steps: Complete the story and all character mission strands.
Finish every hobby and pastime category at least to the checklist's standard.
Complete the required random events and meet every stranger the checklist counts.
Collect every collectible set the checklist tracks — the card sets are the usual straggler.
Open Stats, then the 100% Checklist, and chase the remaining lines until it reads 100%.

trophies.guide: Leonida is littered with stunt opportunities — jumps, ramps, billboard gaps and dock launches — and the game counts every unique stunt you land. Two hundred and fifty sounds like a lot until you treat the map as a stunt park: clear them district by district in a fast, durable car or on a sports bike, and always land on your wheels, facing the way you were travelling. Failed stunts can be retried on the spot; the counter only cares about clean landings.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list: stunt locations
steps: Pick a fast car or sports bike and start with the Vice City beachfront and causeway jumps.
Work district by district, clearing stunt icons as they reveal themselves on the map.
Land cleanly — wheels down, no roll, no bounce into a wall — for the stunt to count.
Keep going to 250; the trophy tracks the cumulative total, not a streak.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: A sampler trophy: every activity type in the game — races, drone races, fishing, arcade games, the shooting range, meditation spots and the rest — needs to be attempted exactly once. Winning does not matter and neither does finishing; starting each type once is the whole job. Most hunters pop this by accident inside their first ten hours.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list: activity types
steps: Open the map's activity legend and note each distinct activity icon type.
Start one event of every type: a race, a drone race, fishing, an arcade game, the shooting range, a meditation spot, and any remaining types your map shows.
The trophy pops when the last untouched type is attempted.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: All 42 Shooting Range challenges, gold in every one. Medals are scored on accuracy and time, and each weapon class runs its own set of challenges. Learn a challenge's target pattern at silver pace first, then push: gold scores reward rhythm more than raw speed. Combat Focus is disabled in the range — this one is pure aim. Save it for after the story, when your shooting stats are at their peak.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list: Shooting Range challenges
steps: Finish the story first so your weapon stats and arsenal are at their best.
Clear each weapon class's challenges at any medal to learn the target patterns.
Replay for gold: pre-aim where the next target will appear and keep a steady cadence.
Gold all 42 challenges — the trophy tracks the medal held on each one.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Top Fun runs drone time-trials at a string of locations across the state, and you need a win — beating the target time — at every one. The drones are twitchy but the courses are short; the trick is cutting the inside of each gate and never braking for a turn you can drift. Learn a course's line with one practice run, then take the win and move on.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list: Top Fun drone races
steps: Find each Top Fun drone race location on the map.
Learn the gate line with a practice run, then beat the target time to win.
Win at every location; the trophy pops with the final course.

trophies.guide: Twenty wins, twenty different races — repeating the same event does not add to the count. Street, off-road, boat and air races all qualify. The early races are tuned gently, so harvest those first, and save the Vice City street series for when you own something quick: a tuned car of your own beats the borrowed options almost every time.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list: races
steps: Win the beginner street and off-road races that open early.
Move through boat and air races as they unlock, winning each new event once.
Keep count as you go — the trophy needs 20 distinct race wins, not 20 wins in total.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal is the fishing contact you meet along the coast, and his challenge is a one-on-one catch contest scored on the value of what you haul in before the timer ends. Upgrade your rod and bait before you take him on, fish the marked hotspots rather than open water, and do not waste casts on the small stuff — two big catches beat six tiddlers.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list: activities
steps: Meet Cal through the coastal story stretch and accept his fishing challenge.
Fish the marked hotspots with your best rod and bait; release nothing, keep everything that scores.
Finish the timer with a higher total catch value than Cal's.

trophies.guide: Leonida's bars and boardwalks hide working arcade cabinets. Finishing any one cabinet's game — a full playthrough to its win or end state, not just feeding it a credit — earns the trophy. The beachfront arcade holds the quickest machine to complete.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
steps: Find an arcade cabinet — the Vice Beach boardwalk arcade is the easiest stop.
Play one game through to completion rather than quitting at the first screen.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's strand runs from small-time errands to a finale that earns him his way out. Strands unlock in stages as the story advances; if Andy's icon vanishes from the map, progress the story and check again. His final mission is the long one — go in prepared, and the trophy follows at its conclusion.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list: Strangers & Freaks strands
steps: Start Andy's strand when his icon appears and work each meeting as it unlocks.
Progress the main story whenever the strand pauses between stages.
Complete Andy's final mission to close the strand and earn the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's strand is the maritime one — boats, docks, and things that were definitely not boat accidents. Work his missions as they appear around the Keys and the coast; his finale is a set-piece on the water, so arrive with a character rested and a fast boat in mind.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
steps: Take Kenton's missions around the coast and the Keys as they unlock.
Push through the strand's stages, returning after story progress when it pauses.
Complete Kenton's final mission on the water.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy rides alone, and his strand feels it: long highway runs and one-on-one trouble. His final mission closes the strand for good, so finish anything else you want from him first. The trophy pops when the strand does.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list: Strangers & Freaks strands
steps: Follow Billy's strand from his first roadside meeting.
Complete each stage as the story opens the next.
Finish Billy's final mission to earn the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Eight full stranger strands, completed — not merely started. Strangers appear as question-mark icons all over Leonida, and each strand is a short chain of meetings. Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone carry the long ones; the rest are shorter encounters scattered through the cities and the swamp. If a strand seems stalled, leave the area and come back after a day of in-game time: several only advance between meetings.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list: stranger strands
steps: Start every stranger strand you find; the long five belong to Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone.
Return to each contact after story progress or a day of in-game time when a strand pauses.
Close out strands one by one until eight are fully complete.
The silver pops on the eighth strand's final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's strand is the supply business: moving product, watching rivals, and a finale where the economics turn violent. Play his missions as they surface during the mid-game and keep the strand warm between story chapters; its last job is the trophy.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list: Strangers & Freaks strands
steps: Pick up Randy's strand when it surfaces in the mid-game.
Work his supply missions as each stage unlocks.
Complete Randy's final mission to earn the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand runs through Vice City's club scene and out the other side. His final mission is a loud one with a vehicle section worth patience: let the traffic thin out rather than forcing gaps that are not there. Completion of the strand finale is the whole requirement.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
steps: Start Tyrone's strand in Vice City and follow its stages.
Progress the story when the strand pauses between meetings.
Complete Tyrone's final mission to earn the trophy.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Eighteen meditation spots are tucked across the state — hilltops, pier ends, quiet beaches at dawn. Each asks for one short, peaceful interaction: no enemies, no timer. They are the calmest collectible in the game and the easiest to sweep region by region with the map open, ideally strung along routes you are travelling anyway.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list: meditation spots
steps: Find a first meditation spot — the pier ends and hilltops are reliable — to learn the interaction.
Sweep the remaining spots region by region; discovered spots stay marked on your map.
Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret, the hunter contact, keeps a list of unique animals — one-off legendary creatures in set habitats. Track one through its region, bring the right bait and a caliber that will not ruin the pelt, and carry the proof back to him. The great gator of the grass rivers is the most forgiving first target; the panther is not.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list: hunting
steps: Meet Bret and take his unique-animal list.
Track one unique animal in its habitat, using bait and a clean, heavy shot.
Return the pelt to Bret to complete the hunt and earn the trophy.

trophies.guide: Collectible cards are scattered through Leonida in themed sets — landmarks, legends, local celebrities. Completing any three full sets earns the silver. Cards sit in interiors and on rooftops as often as on the street, so a systematic district-by-district sweep beats wandering. Your phone's collection screen tracks which sets you have open and how many cards each one still hides.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list: collectible cards
steps: Open the collection screen on your phone and pick the three shortest sets to target.
Sweep district by district, checking interiors and rooftops, not just streets.
Finish one full set, then the next, until three sets are complete.
The trophy pops when the third set closes.

trophies.guide: WAiNK is Leonida's augmented-reality craze: point your phone at a WAiNK spot, complete the little overlay ritual, move on. A hundred locations sounds steep, but the spots cluster — a single Vice City block can hold four. Sweep them while doing other business in each district and the counter climbs on its own until the last twenty or so, which deserve one dedicated evening.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list: WAiNK locations
steps: Do a first WAiNK spot to learn the phone interaction.
Clear spots district by district as you travel for other trophies.
Check your counter in the phone app and plan a final sweep for the stragglers.
Reach 100 locations WAiNKed.

trophies.guide: Challenges are the game's rotating task list — drive this, photograph that, survive the other — offered by contacts, apps and notice boards. Fifty completions is a background trophy across a full playthrough: keep two or three active at all times and hand them in as you pass their waypoints. Story-adjacent challenges pay out fastest.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list: challenges
steps: Keep two or three challenges active from contacts and notice boards at all times.
Complete and hand them in as your other trophy work takes you past their objectives.
Reach 50 completed challenges.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: A partner trophy: both characters, together in free roam, need to earn four stars and then lose every one of them. The reliable method is to make loud trouble somewhere rural, then break line of sight and sit tight — swamp, parking structure, a drainage tunnel — until the stars drain away. Both characters must be together when the heat arrives and still together when it leaves.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list: partner trophies
steps: Bring Jason and Lucia together in free roam, away from the city.
Commit crimes in the open until the wanted level reaches four stars.
Break line of sight and hide until the wanted level fully clears — with your partner still beside you.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Three shop robberies inside one unbroken wanted streak, with your partner along for all of them. Pick a strip of shops along a single street, keep the mask on and the engine running, and move fast between tills: the streak breaks the moment your wanted level fully clears, so never hide between jobs. A wanted level that dips is fine; one that empties ends the run.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list: partner trophies
steps: With your partner, choose three shops close together on one street.
Rob the first shop and keep your wanted level alive as you drive to the second.
Rob the second and third shops without the wanted level ever fully clearing.

trophies.guide: Discovery counts the first time you drive each distinct vehicle model. A hundred sounds like a fleet, but Vice City traffic does most of the work: swap cars at every district change, sweep the parked rows at the airport, the marina and the rich neighborhoods, and remember that boats and aircraft count too.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list: vehicles
steps: Drive every new model you see in traffic rather than passing it by.
Sweep the airport, marina and wealthy districts for parked exotics and utility vehicles.
Add boats and aircraft to reach 100 distinct vehicles discovered.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus — the slow-motion aiming state — needs five takedowns inside a single activation. Set the table first: a crowded enemy group at mid-range, a full magazine, and your Focus meter charged. Trigger it as the group commits to you, work from the closest threat outward, and if the gun runs dry, switch weapons instead of spending the window on a reload.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list: combat trophies
steps: Charge your Combat Focus meter and find a group of five or more enemies at mid-range.
Enter Combat Focus as they engage and drop the closest threats first.
Land five takedowns before the single activation ends.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Vice City International Airport does not approve of your travel plans. Get airside with a vehicle, take a plane that was never cleared for you, and get airborne: the trophy pops as the wheels leave VCIA ground. Expect the full welcome committee on the runway — a fast approach and a short takeoff roll are the whole trick.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list: secret trophies
steps: Drive through a VCIA perimeter gate and onto the airfield.
Board a parked plane and start your takeoff roll immediately.
Get airborne out of VCIA to make the departure official.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a wink: Rhinos are the army's tanks, and it does get warm in one. Steal a Rhino — drawn out by a six-star response, or found where the army parks them — and spend time raising hell inside it: the trophy pops after a sustained stretch in the tank rather than for any single act. Stay rolling, because a stationary Rhino is a swarmed Rhino.
steps: Draw out or locate a Rhino tank — a six-star response brings the army to you.
Get inside and keep moving; a rolling tank survives, a parked one gets swarmed.
Stay in the Rhino causing mayhem until the trophy pops.
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list: secret trophies

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: The quiet counterpart to every loud robbery on this list. Case the jewelry store first, go in masked, control the room without firing a shot, and be gone before any alarm state registers. If a single witness completes a call, restart the attempt — detection anywhere in the job voids it.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list: robberies
steps: Scope the jewelry store and plan a silent entry and exit.
Rob it masked and quiet — no shots, no completed witness calls.
Leave the area clean; the trophy pops once the take is yours and nobody ever knew.

trophies.guide: Bank vaults are the heavyweight robberies of free roam: breach the vault, take the money, and escape the response — five times, each with a clean getaway. The escape is part of the requirement, so plan the exit before the entry: a fast car staged out back and a change of vehicle two blocks away will carry most attempts.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list: robberies
steps: Locate a bank vault job and stage a getaway car before you go in.
Breach the vault, take the cash, and run the planned exit.
Change vehicles or break line of sight to complete the escape.
Repeat at five different bank vaults.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Armored trucks run set routes through the cities. The classic blitz: block the truck, blow the rear doors, take the cash, and be gone inside a minute. The trophy needs the escape as well as the robbery, so have the getaway ready before the doors come off.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list: robberies
steps: Find an armored truck on its route and block it with your vehicle.
Blow the rear doors, grab the cash, and move immediately.
Escape the response to complete the blitz.

trophies.guide: Uncover the whole map. Every district, island and swamp road counts toward explored territory, and the fog lifts simply by being there. A helicopter or seaplane makes short work of the coastline and the Keys; the last stubborn patches are usually interior swamp and the far shore of the lake. Fly a grid pattern first, then drive whatever is left.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list: exploration
steps: Uncover the cities and highways as the story opens the map.
Take a helicopter or seaplane over the Keys, the coast and the lake to clear the water edges.
Drive the remaining fogged patches — the interior swamp is the usual last holdout.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Each of Leonida's gangs runs illegal operations — stash houses, chop shops, grow sites — which are marked once you discover or are told about them. Rob at least one operation belonging to every gang. These places fight back harder than shops do, and robbing one gang tends to annoy exactly that gang, so vary your order and keep a fast car waiting outside.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list: gang operations
steps: Discover each gang's illegal operations through exploration and contacts.
Rob one operation per gang, with a getaway car staged outside.
Finish the set — one successful robbery against every gang's operation.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: A quiet one, hidden for the pleasure of finding it. Go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail at a beachfront bar, and drink it looking at the water. The trophy is the game's deliberate deep breath — and a nod to where a Vice City story ought to begin. Daytime or sunset, it does not matter; the view is the point.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list: secret trophies
steps: Head to a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach, in Vice City's south.
Order a cocktail and drink it facing the ocean.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Find a vehicle showroom with a car you like inside, get into it, and leave through the glass. The 'classic style' is exactly what you are picturing: engine first, doors never. Any showroom car works — the trophy cares about the exit, not the price tag.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list: secret trophies
steps: Enter a vehicle showroom and get into one of the display cars.
Accelerate straight out through the showroom glass.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: A series in-joke with a long memory. Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and complete the follow-through — the alley's own little ritual, best discovered by working the lanes and the front desk rather than forcing it. If nothing triggers, come back at a different hour; the alley keeps office hours in more ways than one.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list: secret trophies
steps: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley in Vice City.
Play the lanes and follow through on the alley's ritual until the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: Jason and Lucia's partnership has its own standing, raised by doing things together: missions played as a pair, partner activities, watching each other's backs in free roam. This trophy marks the partnership reaching its peak. It comes naturally if you play the pair as a pair — bring the other character along whenever the game offers the choice instead of leaving them at home.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list: partner trophies
steps: Play story missions with both characters whenever the pair is offered.
Do partner activities together in free roam — robberies, drives, downtime.
Keep raising the partnership standing until it peaks and the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: The missable trophy of Grand Theft Auto VI — the only one on this list that a single playthrough can lose. Late in the story the game forces a choice between two allegiances, and this trophy hangs on how that choice is made; the wrong branch, taken once, closes it until a fresh run reaches the same point. Keep the manual save you made at the end of Chapter 4, choose with your eyes open, and if the trophy does not pop, reload and take the other road. Everything else in this game forgives you. This one does not.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list: missable trophies (community-verified)
steps: Keep the manual save from the end of Chapter 4 in its own slot, and never overwrite it.
When the late-story choice arrives, commit to one branch and play it through to the mission's end.
If the trophy has not popped, reload the Chapter 4 save and take the other branch.

trophies.guide: A hidden joke at your expense: this trophy rewards a particular failure followed by success — going down inside a set-piece and finishing it on the retry. The dependable place is a story chase with a real fail state: let it beat you once, honestly, then clear it on the second attempt and the game acknowledges the comeback.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list: secret trophies
steps: Pick a story set-piece with a fail state — a chase is the reliable choice.
Fail it once, on purpose or otherwise, and take the retry.
Complete it on the second attempt to earn the trophy.

trophies.guide: Leonida's swamps keep a secret, and it keeps late hours. Hunters report strange lights over the grass rivers in the small hours of a clear night: be out there, away from the roads, between midnight and dawn, and watch the sky when the radio starts to misbehave. Some trophies you earn. This one you witness.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list: secret trophies
steps: Head into the grass rivers, away from roads and towns, on a clear night.
Stay between midnight and dawn and watch for the lights when the radio turns strange.
Witness the event through to its end.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Ten pedestrians, one vehicle, no gunfire: knock people down with melee contact from a moving car — the game counts the contact, not the damage. A crowded beachfront sidewalk at a crawl is the efficient way to farm it: ten gentle topples, barely a wanted star to show for it, trophy bowled.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list: combat trophies
steps: Find a crowded sidewalk — the Ocean Beach front at midday is ideal.
Drive slowly along it, clipping pedestrians with the car or a melee swing from the seat.
Reach 10 knockdowns by melee drive-by.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked Bills come from robberies — cash too hot to spend until your contacts wash it, at a cut. A quarter of a million laundered is a career total, not a single job: feed every marked payout through the laundering contacts instead of spending around it, and prioritize the big scores — bank vaults and cartel money — once the system opens up. Your phone tracks the running washed total.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list: money trophies
steps: Unlock the laundering contacts through the story and strand missions.
Route every Marked Bills payout from robberies through them instead of spending it raw.
Prioritize the big scores — bank vaults and the Cartel Heist money — to move the total quickly.
Reach $250,000 laundered, tracked on your phone.

trophies.guide: A hundred thousand dollars spent in shops — clothes, weapons, vehicle work, boat gear: all of it counts, and it accumulates across the whole game. Most hunters cross the line while kitting out for the endgame without noticing. If you are somehow short late, a full wardrobe refresh for both characters and one top-end vehicle build closes the gap in a single spree.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list: money trophies
steps: Spend normally as you play — weapons, clothes and vehicle work all count.
Check your lifetime shop spend in the stats if you are closing on the platinum.
If you are short, kit out both characters and build one top-end vehicle to cross $100,000.

trophies.guide: Every garage property on the market, bought and owned at the same time. Garages unlock for purchase as the story opens their districts; the total bill is the real requirement, so this trophy pairs with the money ones — launder, rob and save until the last deed is affordable, then buy the map clean.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list: property trophies
steps: Unlock garage properties district by district as the story opens the map.
Build the cash reserve with robberies and laundering rather than spending as you go.
Buy every garage property on the market.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app registers vehicles you own — or have recently acquired — for retrieval around the city. Register ten different vehicles: drive one, open the app, register it, repeat. Distinct vehicles count, not repeat registrations of the same car, and the garages from Little Boxes make the last few registrations a formality.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app with the first vehicle you want on call.
Register vehicles as you acquire them — one registration per distinct vehicle.
Reach 10 registered vehicles.
